en.t: (4) This book has English, German, and French translations.

units.source_text: 英译本最早，刊于一九二一年，译者瓦勒（Arthur Waley），书名*The Tale of Genji*。

en.t: The English translation was the earliest, published in 1921; the translator was Waley (Arthur Waley), and the title was *The Tale of Genji*.

units.source_text: 德译本有二种，一是赫利芝卡（Herbart E.Herlitschka）所译，书名*Die Geschichte von Prinzen Genji*；

en.t: There are two German translations: one was translated by Herbart E. Herlitschka, under the title *Die Geschichte von Prinzen Genji*;

units.source_text: 二是缪勒扎勃希（Maximilian Müller-Jabüsch）所译，书名*Die Aventeur der Prinzen Genji*。

en.t: the other was translated by Maximilian Müller-Jabüsch, under the title *Die Aventeur der Prinzen Genji*.

units.source_text: 法译本译者是归化法国之日本人山田氏，书名*Le Romance de Genji*。

en.t: The translator of the French version was Mr. Yamada, a Japanese person who had become a naturalized French citizen, and the title was *Le Romance de Genji*.
